Present.description: Values no member admits by its kind (null and false, for a string) are left out without a warning.

Partly.description: true is left out of boolean; "a", which string admits by its kind, is not, with a warning on it.

PartlyNull.description: null is left out; "a" and "b" are not, with a warning on each.

PartlyRef.description: null is left out of the member that lists it, not of the reference, which may admit it.
